text: Medium: any member of a private channel (not only a channel admin) can add any actor via POST /members, giving them the full history, while removal and edit need the admin role (assertCanManage); inconsistent BFLA. Fix: require channel admin (or document that every member may invite).
reason: Slack parity (Michal 2026-11-04: UI ma w pelni odwzorowywac Slacka): w Slacku kazdy czlonek kanalu prywatnego moze dodac innych; to swiadome zachowanie, nie BFLA. Opisac w docs w T-MG-2.
